integrity: The fresh primary manuscript was inspected through its variance definitions, monotonicity, main two-variance theorem, and sharp regular-polygon example. The original extremal conjecture and a full public proof of the required boundary Phelps-Rodriguez rigidity were also inspected. The new argument is analytic: equality in the two-sided variance chain forces equality in the strict power-mean inequality, hence circular root geometry, after which the boundary rigidity theorem gives the regular-polygon polynomial.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies equality for every finite superquadratic Borcea variance exponent. It does not classify equality at the quadratic endpoint, does not prove the stronger subquadratic variance inequalities, and does not give quantitative stability for near-extremizers.
title: Superquadratic Phelps–Rodrigues rigidity for Borcea variance
